The wind will remain calm, at 0 km/h, which will allow the rain to accumulate in these areas, potentially leading to flash flooding.

As the rain falls, the roads will become slippery, and the reduced visibility will make it difficult for drivers to navigate. Residents in areas like Maitama and Wuse can expect the roads to be particularly congested, as these areas tend to experience more flooding during heavy rainfall. The cloud cover will be extensive, with a UV index of 0, which means that the sun will be completely obscured for most of the day. As the day progresses, the rain will start to clear, and the skies will start to partially clear, allowing for some sunshine to peek through the clouds. The models suggest that the rain will be most intense in the southern parts of the city, near the Aso Rock area, where the terrain is more conducive to orographic lift. This will lead to a higher accumulation of rain in these areas, potentially exceeding 30 mm. However, this is still within the realm of uncertainty, and my best guess is that the actual accumulation will be closer to 20-25 mm.
